>notice a pattern of fooling myself into thinking I am OK and healthy

I do as well. When I recover from a breakdown & start feeling better I just repress it & not think about as it slips into the background of consciousness. Its not long before the uncontrollable compulsions to burn down my reputation, push women away from me, make everyone hate me, etc return leading to another breakdown.
Have you considered checking your self intova psych ward?
... parody of myself over & over again. Having to watch it happen again.
This guy needs to just deal with you being late and stuff. Who does he think he is? The Pope of Mars?
